title: OpenAI's new AI smart speaker will reportedly sell for between $300 and $400
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Additional details about OpenAI's mysterious new AI device make it sound like a pricey smart speaker.
body:
## Introduction to OpenAI's New Smart Speaker
OpenAI is set to release a revolutionary AI-powered smart speaker, described as the physical embodiment of ChatGPT. This innovative device is expected to be donut-shaped, allowing users to effortlessly move it around their home and place it in various locations. Constructed from high-quality metal, the speaker will boast a premium look and intriguingly, feature distinct moving parts.

## Technology and Design
The smart speaker's design is the result of a collaboration between OpenAI and LoveFrom, a renowned design studio founded by former Apple developer Jony Ive. This partnership has led to the creation of a unique and potentially game-changing device. Although the exact functionality of the moving parts is unclear, the speaker's ability to integrate ChatGPT into users' daily lives is a significant development. The device's portability and sleek design are expected to set it apart from existing smart speakers on the market.

## Market Implications and Release
With a projected price point of $300 to $400, OpenAI's smart speaker may face challenges in a market where profitability has been elusive for many manufacturers. Nevertheless, the company's foray into the hardware market is a strategic move to further integrate ChatGPT into users' lives. Despite being sued by Apple over alleged trade secret theft, OpenAI is pushing forward with the device's development, with a planned release in 2027.
